//: Deno config for the Edge Function tree. Introduced by T-020, which needed somewhere to run its spec: there was no Deno config, no Deno test and no Deno step in CI, so the row's proof had nowhere to execute. T-027 widens this to `deno check supabase/functions/**/*.ts` wired into `npm run check`; until then CI runs `deno test --no-check` here, so a red run means the behaviour under test broke and nothing else.
